title: TDSR CSS-2 counts only palette colours left as literals or in the wrong role, reads the newest WordPress theme, and the re-tokenized themes keep their default look
expect: S1: every test passes, including a preset accent variable wrapped by accentVars not counted, a colour outside the palette not counted, a Tailwind variable not counted, a palette hex counted, and JA Impact's newest theme zip 1.0.10 read before the 1.0.9 one numbered like the release.
S2: every test passes: JA Essence's sheets read the slot with every read keeping a fallback, JA Kinetic declares 1.1.14, the door offers the moved maxVersion and refuses the next one.
evidence: Before this fix the Design system step reported 13 releases failing CSS-2, 5 of them falsely (a preset variable, fenced design pages, a Tailwind variable, a colour outside the palette)
fence: The default look of every re-tokenized release is unchanged: WordPress 0 differences under no system, Joomla 0 computed differences against the released version
